name: Data City
description: A 3D bar chart that grows like a city skyline at night, built in Three.js: navy towers with lit windows, glowing cyan-to-magenta roofs, a grid floor fading into fog, and values floating above each tower.
best_use_cases: Making numbers feel like a city
style: 3D in Three.js: tower heights exactly proportional to the values, a slow orbit around the skyline, the tallest tower gets a light beam and a callout, then the camera rises over the city for the takeaway number.
